'''Grukk's Jungle''' was located on the [[Ugnaught Surface/Legends|Ugnaught Surface]], surrounded by the [[Irden]] tribal warrens, the former Northeast Refineries, and [[Zavlabar's Gentes Grill]]. A portion of the [[Ugnorgrad Swampway]] ran through the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]].<ref name="ActionTidings2" />
